name: Proto-Kartvelian (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Proto-Kartvelian is the reconstructed common ancestor of the Kartvelian (South Caucasian) family, including Georgian. It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern varieties that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table: the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table needs a cited reconstruction that states its notation and the sound value of each symbol.

sources.author: Klimov, G. A.
sources.title: Etymological Dictionary of the Kartvelian Languages
sources.notes: Reference for Kartvelian reconstruction (structural node only).
